The 18-variable Jacobian has exact rank ten at both generic normal forms (integer unit pivots), rank eight at nonzero proportional pairs, and zero at origin, so tangent dimensions are 8, 10, 18 respectively. Generic tangent excess two proves generically nonreduced, and a concrete dual-number deformation realizes a nonzero nilpotent coordinate function. Rational point and q+4 orbit counts follow by independent line/plane flag counting. Exhaustive q=2,3 checker verifies points, orbits and tangent dimensions but does not replace the infinite-field proofs.

Both irreducible components are generically thickened by two extra first-order tangent directions despite identical closed points to a radical-square-zero quotient, and an explicit product coordinate detects the difference. Complete rational orbits add natural arithmetic resolution rather than a narrow arbitrary instance; no paper-scale or downstream theorem is claimed.
